options: As we know how to swim, we can have more fun.
As we didn't know how to swim, we couldn't have more fun.
As we don't know how to swim, we can't have more fun.
As we knew how to swim, we could have more fun.
As we hadn't known how to swim, we couldn't have had more fun.
questions.question:
다음 중 주어진 문장의 의미가 같은 것은?

If we knew how to swim, we could have more fun.
questions.explanation: 2형식 가정법은 현재 사실과 반대이므로 현재 수영을 모른다는 의미입니다.

options: If we had arrived in time, we could have caught the bus.
If we have not arrived in time, we could catch the bus.
As we didn't want to arrive in time, we could catch the bus.
As we didn't want to catch the bus, we need to hurry up.
If we had not arrived in time, we could have caught the bus.
questions.question:
다음 중 주어진 문장의 의미가 같은 것은?

We didn't arrive in time, so we couldn't catch the bus.
questions.explanation: 3형식 가정법(과거)에서 had arrived와 could have caught을 사용합니다.

options: If my little sister often lay down on the ground, her clothes wouldn't usually be kept clean.
If my little sister often lay down on the ground, her clothes were usually kept clean.
If my little sister often laid down on the ground, her clothes wouldn't usually be kept clean.
If my little sister often lied down on the ground, her clothes wouldn't usually be kept clean.
If my little sister often lied down on the ground, her clothes would usually be kept clean.
questions.question:
다음 중 주어진 문장의 의미가 같은 것은?

As my little sister doesn't often lie down on the ground, her clothes are usually kept clean.
questions.explanation: 2형식 가정법에서 현재 사실과 반대 조건을 나타내려면 laid down과 wouldn't usually be kept를 사용합니다.

options: If he is not poor, he can buy an expensive car.
If he is poor, he can buy an expensive car.
If he were poor, he could buy an expensive car.
If he were not poor, he could buy an expensive car.
If he were not poor, he couldn't buy an expensive car.
questions.question:
다음 문장을 가정법으로 바르게 바꾼 것은?

As he is poor, he can't buy an expensive car.
questions.explanation: 현재 사실과 반대되는 가정이므로 were not과 could buy를 사용합니다.

options: He has a key, so he couldn't open the door.
He doesn't have a key, so he can't open the door.
As he didn't have a key, he couldn't open the door.
As he doesn't have a key, he doesn't open the door.
He didn't have a key, so he can't open the door.
questions.question:
다음 가정법 문장을 직설법으로 바르게 바꾼 것은?

If he had a key, he could open the door.
questions.explanation: 2형식 가정법은 현재 사실과 반대이므로 열쇠가 없다는 의미입니다.

options: If Tom were rich, he could buy a building.
If Tom was rich, he could not buy a building.
If Tom could buy a building, he was not rich.
If Tom could not buy a building, he was rich.
If Tom were not rich, he could buy a building.
questions.question:
다음 문장을 가정법으로 바르게 바꾼 것은?

Tom can't buy a building because he isn't rich.
questions.explanation: 현재 사실과 반대되는 가정이므로 were와 could를 사용합니다.

options: He wasn't busy, but he couldn't go to the movies.
He is busy, so he can't go to the movies.
Though he isn't busy, he could go to the movies.
He was busy, so he couldn't go to the movies.
As he was busy, he couldn't go to the movies.
questions.question:
다음 문장을 가정법으로 바르게 바꾼 것은?

If he were not busy, he could go to the movies.
questions.explanation: 2형식 가정법은 현재 사실과 반대이므로 현재 바쁘다는 의미입니다.

options: If I go to Africa for volunteer work, I will help poor children there.
If I don't go to Africa for volunteer work, I won't help poor children there.
If I went to Africa, I could help poor children there.
If I didn't go Africa, I could help poor children there.
If I went to Africa, I couldn't help poor children there.
questions.question:
다음 문장을 가정법으로 바르게 바꾼 것은?

As I don't go to Africa for volunteer work, I can't help poor children there.
questions.explanation: 현재 사실과 반대되는 가정이므로 went와 could를 사용합니다.

options: It's raining, so I won't go for a walk. → If it weren't raining, I would go for a walk.
Since he's not good at playing tennis, he can't become a professional player. → If he were good at playing tennis, he could become a professional player.
As he is sick, he can't go to see her. → If he were not sick, he could go to see her.
As it rains hard, we don't play outside. → If it doesn't rain hard, we would play outside.
As we don't have enough money, we don't buy the camera. → If we had enough money, we would buy the camera.
questions.question: 다음 중 문장 전환이 어법상 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: 현재 사실을 반대로 가정하는 가정법 과거 문장으로 바꿀 때는 If절에 과거형 동사를 써야 합니다. 현재 긍정문(rains)을 반대로 가정해야 하므로 과거 부정형인 didn't rain으로 고쳐야 주절의 would play와 시제가 일치합니다.

options: A: He can't buy it because he has no money. B: He could buy it if he had some money.
A: You didn't call me, so I couldn't help you. B: If you had called me, I could have helped you.
A: As he doesn't have time, he will not go to Spain. B: If he had time, he would go to Spain.
A: Because we didn't go by car, we didn't save time. B: If we had gone by car, we would have saved time.
A: The exam was so difficult that she got a low score. B: If the exam had been difficult, she would have gotten a low score.
questions.question: 다음 중 문장 전환이 어법상 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: 과거의 역사적 사실이나 지나간 일을 반대로 가정할 때는 가정법 과거완료(If + 주어 + had p.p., 주어 + 조동사 과거형 + have p.p.)를 씁니다.  "시험이 어려워서 낮은 점수를 받았다"는 과거의 사실을 반대로 뒤집어야 하므로, "시험이 그렇게 어렵지 않았더라면(hadn't been), 낮은 점수를 받지 않았을 텐데(wouldn't have gotten)"와 같이 부정형으로 전환해야 문맥과 어법이 모두 맞습니다. 주어진 문장 B는 사실을 그대로 대입하여 해석이 "시험이 어려웠었더라면, 낮은 점수를 받았을 텐데"라는 어색한 문장이 됩니다.

options: He is not strong, so he can't carry this box. → If he is strong, he can carry this box.
As I have no money, I can't buy the car. → If I had money, I could buy the car.
It is raining, so I won't go for a walk. → If it weren't raining, I'd go for a walk.
My sister is crying because mom's not here. → If mom were here, my sister wouldn't be crying.
We can't travel more because we don't have a car. → We could travel more if we had a car.
questions.question: 다음 두 문장의 의미가 같지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ①번은 원래 문장에서 '강하지 않다'는 의미인데, 가정법으로 바꾸면 현재 사실과 반대가 되어 '강하면'이 되어야 하므로 의미가 맞습니다. 실제로 모두 의미가 맞는데, ①번 원문을 다시 보면 If he is strong은 현재 사실로 표현되어 있어 틀렸습니다.

options: It rains, so I stay home. → If it rains, I would not stay home.
I don't have wings, so I can't fly. → If I had wings, I couldn't fly.
If she were kind, many people would like her. → She is kind, but many people don't like her.
I don't know him, so I can't introduce him to you. → If I knew him, I could introduce him to you.
I don't have wings, so I can't fly to school. → If I had had wings, I could fly to school.
questions.question: 다음 두 문장의 의미가 같은 것은?
questions.explanation: ④번이 올바른 2형식 가정법으로 변환되었습니다.

options: As I didn't have a pen, I couldn't write you a letter. → If I had had a pen, I could have wrote you a letter.
She can't go because she is busy. → She could have gone if she weren't busy.
He couldn't buy the ring because it was too expensive. → If the ring wasn't too expensive he could have bought it.
She couldn't see the movie because she was 13 years old. → If she weren't 13 years old, she could have seen the movie.
As there are so many cars, there is so much air pollution. → There wouldn't be so much air pollution if there weren't so many cars.
questions.question: 다음 중 직설법을 가정법으로 바르게 바꾼 것은?
questions.explanation: ⑤번이 올바르게 현재 상황의 반대를 나타내고 있습니다.

options: If I were not tired, I could go to the movies. = I'm tired, so I can't go to the movies.
He doesn't help me, so I can't do it. = If he helped me, I could do it.
If I knew his number, I could call him. = As I don't know his number, I can't call him.③
If there wasn't so much traffic, the air would be clean. = Because there is so much traffic, the air isn't clean.
If I were born in America, I could speak English fluently. = I was born in America, but I can't speak English fluently.
questions.question: 다음 짝지어진 두 문장의 의미가 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: 가정법 문장은 "미국에서 태어나지 않았다"는 사실을 반대로 가정하고 있습니다. 따라서 직설법 문장으로 바꿀 때는 As I wasn't born in America, I can't speak English fluently.(내가 미국에서 태어나지 않았기 때문에, 영어를 유창하게 하지 못한다)가 되어야 앞뒤 의미가 똑같아집니다. 주어진 문장은 실제 사실을 완전히 오해하여 표현했으므로 어색합니다.

options: I am lonely, for she isn't here. → If she were here, she wouldn't be lonely.
It's raining, so I won't go for a walk. → If it weren't raining, I'd go for a walk.
My little sister is crying because my mom's not here. → If my mom were not here, my little sister wouldn't be crying.
As you don't come, I don't have more time to talk with you. → If you come, I would not have more time to talk with you.
Since he's not very good at playing basketball, he can't become a professional player. → If he were very good at playing basketball, he couldn't become a professional player.
questions.question: 다음 중 두 문장의 의미가 같은 것은?
questions.explanation: ②번이 올바르게 의미가 같게 표현되었습니다.

options: You don't come to my party, so I am not happy. → If you came to my party, I would be happy.
It isn't hot, so I can take a walk. → If it were hot, I could not take a walk.
He wasn't honest, so they didn't trust him. → If he had been honest, they would trust him.
You didn't clean your room, so it was dirty. → If you had cleaned your room, it wouldn't have been dirty.
I didn't have a car, so I couldn't pick you up. → If I had had a car, I could have picked you up.
questions.question: 다음 문장을 가정법으로 알맞게 진환하지 못한 것은?
questions.explanation: ③번은 "If he had been honest, they would have trusted him"이어야 합니다.

options: If Jinsu had enough money, he could buy a new computer. → As Jinsu doesn't have enough money, he can't buy a new computer.
If I knew his address, I could send him a letter. → As I didn't know his address, I couldn't send him a letter.
As I don't read the book faster, I can't finish it in a day. → If I read the book faster, I could finish it in a day.
As it doesn't rain, I can't see a rainbow. → If it rained, I could see a rainbow.
If I were a bird, I could fly to you. → As I am not a bird, I can't fly to you.
questions.question: 다음 두 문장의 의미가 같지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: 현재 사실을 반대로 가정하는 가정법 과거(If + 과거동사, 조동사과거 + 동사원형) 문장입니다. 따라서 실제 사실을 나타내는 직설법 문장으로 바꿀 때는 과거 시제가 아니라 현재 시제(don't know / can't send)로 고쳐야 합니다. 주어진 문장은 과거의 사실로 왜곡되어 있어 옳지 않습니다.

options: If I knew her name, I would tell you.
If he'd run a bit faster, he could have won.
If my nose were shorter, I would be quite prettty.
I could have died that day if Jack had not helped me.
If you get here before eight, you can catch the early train.
questions.question:
다음 글의 "if"의 쓰임을 보여주는 문장이 아닌 것은?

We use special structures with "if" when we are talking about unreal situations — things that are certainly not happening or did not happen, and situations that are untrue or imaginary.
questions.explanation: 이 문장은 일어나지 못할 일을 상상하는 가정법이 아니라, "8시 전에 오면, 조기 열차를 탈 수 있다"라는 현실적이고 충분히 일어날 수 있는 가능성을 나타내는 단순 조건문(Real Conditional)입니다. 조건절에 현재 시제(get), 주절에 현재/미래 조동사(can catch)가 쓰인 구조로, 제시문에서 말하는 'unreal situation'의 예시로 적절하지 않습니다.

questions.question:
다음 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 어색한 것은?

If I ⓐwas a famous movie star ⓑlike Audrey Hepburn, I ⓒmight not be ⓓinterested in ⓔhelping others.
questions.explanation: ⓐ의 'was'는 'were'가 되어야 합니다. 2형식 가정법에서는 주어가 무엇이든 were를 사용합니다.

options: If I don't have any friends, I would be lonely.
If I find your key, I will tell you.
If she were here, I wouldn't be lonely.
If he knew your situation, he could help you.
If it were not raining, I could go out to play soccer.
questions.question: 다음 If구문 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: 주절에 조동사의 과거형인 would be가 쓰인 것으로 보아, 현재 사실과 반대되는 상황을 가정하는 가정법 과거 문장입니다. 가정법 과거의 공식인 If + 주어 + 동사의 과거형에 맞추어야 하므로, 조건절의 don't have를 과거형 부정인 didn't have로 고쳐야 시제가 올바르게 일치합니다.

options: If I *were* you, I *would see* a doctor.
If the weather *were* better, we *would go* outside.
If he *were* president, he *would help* the poor.
If we *had* more time, we *would swim* all day.
If a dog *runs* after me, I *would run* away.
questions.question: 다음 표시된 부분 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: ①②③④번이 모두 올바른 가정법입니다. ⑤번은 1형식(현재)이므로 would가 없어야 합니다.
